meta.notes: Falcon Hub Airways (fictional). v2 history weeks 0-103 under P0. Options evaluated at request time from information available then (stock before the request, open POs/ROs at quoted dates, published AOG-route odds; never the per-request draws). Material shortage exposure = expected material-related downtime hours (wait beyond the rectification window + fitting/RTS) x rate/h + fixed cost per event (if late) + direct cost; exposure_aed already includes direct_cost. Robbery = engineering/quality approval required, human decision, never ranked. Rectification windows are hypothetical, not operator MEL decisions.

option_labels.local_borrow: Local borrow / third-party loan at the outstation
option_labels.robbery: Robbery from an aircraft at AUH (human decision)

reason_codes.LOCAL_STOCK: Serviceable unit on the shelf at the requesting station
reason_codes.NO_STOCK: No serviceable unit at the source(s)
reason_codes.COMMITTED_TO_KIT: Units on hand are reserved for notified scheduled needs (only D0 needs may break them)
reason_codes.ROBS_KIT_RESERVATION: Feasible only by breaking a scheduled-need reservation (allowed for a D0 need)
reason_codes.NOT_APPLICABLE_AT_HUB: The request is at AUH itself
reason_codes.ROUTINE_SHIPMENT: Window covers routine transit + margin; ships routine at line cost
reason_codes.BELOW_PROTECTION_LEVEL: Donor stations hold stock only at or below their own D0 protection level
reason_codes.LATERAL_OK: Donor outstation keeps its protection level after shipping
reason_codes.CONSUMABLES_EXPENDABLES_ONLY: Route applies to consumables and expendables only
reason_codes.OUTSTATION_ONLY: Local borrow exists only at outstations
reason_codes.HUB_ONLY: Robbery is modelled at AUH only (hangar aircraft in check / parked)
reason_codes.NO_LOCAL_MARKET: No local borrow source at this station for this fleet type
reason_codes.AVAILABILITY_UNCERTAIN: Route available only with probability p; failed attempts are retried
reason_codes.NO_DONOR_AIRCRAFT: No same-type aircraft with the PN fitted that is not already a donor
reason_codes.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Engineering/quality approval required — human decision; never auto-recommended
reason_codes.LOAN_FEE_ACCRUES: Daily fee accrues until the own unit replaces the borrowed unit (estimated)
reason_codes.NOT_CONTRACTED: No pool-exchange agreement in force (P0); P3 terms shown for reference
reason_codes.NO_OPEN_RO: No unit of this PN at a repair shop
reason_codes.NO_QUEUE_TO_JUMP: Every unit at the shop has already started work: priority cannot shorten work content
reason_codes.DOES_NOT_BEAT_ALTERNATIVES: Queue-jump return is not faster than another feasible option
reason_codes.QUEUE_JUMP_OK: Queue-jump return beats the other feasible options
reason_codes.ESTIMATE: Estimate: quoted TAT and a flat surcharge, not a shop quote
reason_codes.OPEN_PO_INBOUND: Earliest usable inbound unit is an open purchase order
reason_codes.INBOUND_TRANSFER: A shipment to this station is already in transit (ETA = ship time + planned transit)
reason_codes.RO_RETURN_INBOUND: Earliest usable inbound unit is a repair return
reason_codes.QUEUED_BEHIND_BACKORDERS: Earlier unfilled requests claim the first inbound units
reason_codes.SUPPLY_OVERDUE: Inbound order is past its quoted date; remaining time assumed
reason_codes.EXCEEDS_DEADLINE: Wait exceeds the rectification window: material-related downtime for the difference plus fitting

route_labels.inbound_transfer: Shipment already in transit to the station
route_labels.inbound_repair: Repair return from the shop (normal supply)
route_labels.inbound_hub_stock: Transfer from AUH once AUH stock was replenished
route_labels.robbery: Robbery from an aircraft at AUH (approval flagged)
route_labels.planned_loan: Pre-arranged exchange / loan for a planned change
route_labels.unfilled: Still unfilled at end of history
